reason: #5105/#5118: the shared verification step (execute-phase and verify-work re-verification) dispatches verify:post hooks BEFORE its own verifier and verification.fingerprint call, so gating on --after-fingerprint would be a no-op there by construction, not a defect.

#5105: secure-phase.md's own dispatch is a standalone activation self-check ("is the secure-phase step active"), not a post-fingerprint re-dispatch. Gating it would move the secure-phase hook into skippedHooks whenever SECURITY.md already exists, breaking the documented standalone re-audit path.

#5105: validate-phase.md's own dispatch is a standalone activation self-check, symmetric with secure-phase.md's — gating it would break the documented standalone re-audit path when VALIDATION.md already exists.
#5105 design census §1b: audit-milestone.md:162 is read-only discovery (§5.5) — it never dispatches a step or writes an artifact, so gating is not applicable.

#5105 design census §1b: $VERIFICATION_FILE is always the phase's own *-VERIFICATION.md report path (resolved via verification.resolve-file) — this is the canonicalization write to the report's own status, which is filtered from the covered-file set (v3) and therefore inert by construction.
